excluded.container_images: pulled from the registry by the recorded image reference
excluded.minio_iam_and_bucket_policy: recreated by minio-bootstrap from the deployment secrets
excluded.model_manifests_and_weights: release artifacts; pins are recorded as configuration references
excluded.redis: ephemeral queue/cache state; jobs are recovered from PostgreSQL (outbox, recovery sweep)
excluded.secrets: JWT/pepper/storage/PII/backup keys live in the secret manager; only names, key ids and keyed fingerprints are recorded
excluded.tombstone_journal: must outlive every backup; replicated separately and replayed on restore
excluded.transient_files: upload quarantine, legacy upload dir, celerybeat schedule

snapshot.isolation: repeatable read, read only, access share locks on every table

postgresql.method: logical COPY in one exported snapshot
